statusRule: ONE rule for every row. A row describes the ROUTE the contract proposes: the shipped mapper (phase2/sketch-map.mjs) plus the guard in contract/sketch-constraints-r3 (guard.mjs: preflight, canonical row-order ladder, post-solve rule residual, post-solve BRANCH check against the drawn start, even-odd profile choice, plain sentences). wrong = at least one measured case (stored geometry, a 3.5% or 15% hand-drawn rough start, a 40% or 80% stress start, a permuted row order, or a param drag) in which the route BUILDS a solid that disagrees with the oracle (closed form, and live brep-rs / OCCT / FreeCAD where they can referee it) and shows no refusal. refused = the feature as written is refused with a plain sentence in every case measured (by design or because SolidCraft cannot hold it). supported = every measured case either builds a solid that matches the oracle within tolerance (planar 1e-9 relative on volume and bbox; curved 3e-4 because truck volumes are tessellation-derived) or is refused with a plain sentence; the stored geometry and the 3.5% / 15% hand-drawn starts build, and the refusal counts at every amplitude are in the evidence. Round 3: every refusal sentence must be exactly ONE sentence (audit.mjs counts them), a driving:false reference is never a request (it is measured, not enforced), and a redundant but consistent row is built while a real conflict is refused. unsupported = could not be measured. Rows that name "shipped ... without the guard" describe the code as it stands today and carry the count of silent wrong builds it produces; they are wrong by the same rule.
rig: SolidCraft fe3717f wasm. This round uses the wrapper2 pkg (SOLIDCRAFT_REFEREE_PKG2 = dir holding solidcraft_referee_p2.js): a wasm-bindgen --target nodejs build of docs/spikes/solidcraft-referee/phase2/wrapper2 against the same fe3717f source as the main pkg. wrapper2 returns every command's result plus the @sketch dump (solved points, SolveReport, profile list) that the phase0 pkg cannot. I did not rebuild it: it is the copy another builder on this run had already built (scratchpad crx/pkg2, 23419164-byte wasm), copied to scratchpad scr2/pkg2. Oracles: closed form (arithmetic next to each case, plus every mirror image that still satisfies the rules: oracle.mjs), live brep-rs wasm archive/brep-rs/pkg, live OCCT replicad-opencascadejs, saved FreeCAD refs docs/replica/freecad/gauntlet/variants/refs. brep-rs and OCCT cannot referee rows that use the built-in axes or construction geometry; and brep-rs puts a circle that was drawn below a line tangent ABOVE it, so brep-rs 'WRONG' counts in the sweeps are brep-rs disagreeing with the drawn side, not evidence against SolidCraft. || ROUND 4 NOTE: the wrapper2 pkg above no longer exists (reboot). Round-4 re-measurements use the phase0 wrapper (docs/spikes/solidcraft-referee/demo/pkg, same referee crate without the sketch dump) through sketch-constraints-r4/pkg2shim; see "recheck".
howToRun: cd <repo>; export SOLIDCRAFT_REFEREE_PKG2=<pkg dir>; sh docs/spikes/solidcraft-referee/contract/sketch-constraints-r3/run-all.sh (sweeps, perm-test, profiles-test, stored-run, param-grid, legacy-run, accuracy, probes: one job at a time under systemd-run --user --scope -p MemoryMax=16G -p MemorySwapMax=0), then bun docs/spikes/solidcraft-referee/contract/sketch-constraints-r3/build-rows.mjs
code: docs/spikes/solidcraft-referee/contract/sketch-constraints-r3/ (guard.mjs, branch.mjs, geom.mjs, legacy.mjs, score.mjs, run-sweeps.mjs, stored-run.mjs, perm-test.mjs, param-grid.mjs, profiles-test.mjs, legacy-run.mjs, accuracy.mjs, probes.mjs, build-rows.mjs; measurements in out/)

round3Fixes.critic: The guarded route builds a constrained sketch on an offset plane or a frame at offset 0 (silent wrong solid)
round3Fixes.done: guardedSketch reads sk.plane / sk.offset / sk.frame and hands them to the mapper; a placement preflight refuses unknown planes and malformed frames; a placement stage after the extrude compares the solid (centre of mass along the normal, in-plane position, world bbox) with the frame and refuses a mismatch. placement.mjs: 83 constrained sketches (3 shapes x 15 placements x stored/rough) all built at the right place against live brep-rs and OCCT; the round-2 route is kept as a control (71 of 71 placed sketches built at offset 0 with no refusal; the placement stage refuses all 71)

round3Fixes.critic: Refusal sentences are not single sentences (38 of 40 permuted-run sentences were two)
round3Fixes.done: CONFLICT and BRANCH rewritten as one sentence, only the first mapper refusal is shown, sentenceCount() lint (refs.mjs) over every final refusal of every run script (ladderSketch logs them to $SENTENCE_LOG; audit.mjs); the wording row now fails on a sentence count other than one

round3Fixes.critic: Redundant but consistent dimensions are refused with a false "they conflict" reason, and slot-extra-radius is order dependent (9 of 16 refused, 7 built)
round3Fixes.done: the guard sets aside a row SolidCraft refuses as already determined, solves the rest, and builds only if the solved sketch meets the set-aside row; otherwise refuses with the conflict sentence. redundant.mjs measures all nine sk-conflict / slot fixtures from docs/replica (FreeCAD refs: redundant and conflicting lists, Invalid sketches with no bbox) stored, 12 rough starts and 16 shuffled row orders each

round3Fixes.critic: Arc rows off the circle refused far more widely than the lock-on-c row says
round3Fixes.done: the preflight is narrowed to an arc whose centre a lock row pins; every other off-circle arc is solved and checked after the solve. exp-arcs.mjs and arcs-fuzz.mjs (hand-typed slots and ovals, ends pushed off the circle by 1e-5 to 2 mm, 280 rough starts per arm) compare with live brep-rs and the closed form; phase2 own-slot-dims-from-points (0.29 mm off) now builds

round3Fixes.critic: driving:false reference: spurious refusal of a reference on the other side of the drawing, wrong value accepted silently
round3Fixes.done: reference rows are never sent to SolidCraft (they add no equation; brep-rs session.rs reference_values says their stored number is stale by design); the route builds what the other rows fix and returns the measured value of every reference (result.references: stored, measured, stale), checked against brep-rs diagnose().references and the closed form; a reference on a non-dimension is refused in one sentence like brep-rs

round3Fixes.critic: Built-in axes in angle, equal and tangent rows, and the other rule kinds, have no row
round3Fixes.done: axes.mjs: 20 rule kind x slot x axis combinations; a tangent to an axis is now refused up front because the independent rule checker cannot read it (it used to throw inside the guard); a guard that throws is a refusal, never a build

round3Fixes.critic: Slider-style param drags cross branches and the single refused row does not enumerate the gaps
round3Fixes.done: param-drags.mjs: eight families (rectangle width, hole diameter, hole centre across the edge, external and internal tangent radius, slot radius, triangle angle in 5 degree steps, signed distanceX across 0, height to 0) as slider steps from the last built geometry and as jumps from the stored one, scored RIGHT / REFUSED-VALID (capability gap) / REFUSED-INVALID / WRONG against closed forms, with live brep-rs on the jumps; one row per family for each outcome class

round3Fixes.critic: Hole drags that make the outline cross itself were refused as a branch
round3Fixes.done: a crossing or self-crossing outline has its own sentence (CROSSING) instead of the branch sentence

round2Fixes.critic: No check after the solve confirms SolidCraft stayed on the drawn branch
round2Fixes.done: guard.mjs now runs five post-solve checks (SolveReport status, independent signed rule residuals, branch.mjs loop / corner / arc / tangent / symmetric / angle-quadrant / cusp features, images.mjs nearest mirror image, evenOddProfiles); every sweep row reports shipped-vs-guarded counts on the same seeds

round2Fixes.critic: Result depends on rule row order
round2Fixes.done: ladder of canonical row orders (JGTD*, GJTD*, GTDJ*, as written), first rung that passes every check wins; perm-test.mjs measures the four named orders and 12 random permutations x 6 starts x 8 fixtures
one STATUS_RULE, statuses derived by deriveStatus() from the measurements; rows that describe the shipped code without the guard are separate rows and are wrong by the same rule
plainMapper / plainSc / preflight sentences name rows of sk.rules() and geometry numbers only; probes.mjs audits every sentence collected from every run against a forbidden-token pattern

round2Fixes.critic: Legacy rows judged at 1e-5 and nothing refuses over-constrained legacy rules
round2Fixes.done: judged at 1e-9; route B (legacy rules as soup rows solved by SolidCraft) meets it, the shipped route A does not (own wrong row); the settle in runScript drops conflicting rules silently (own wrong row, upstream); unsettled fights are refused by an independent residual check

round2Fixes.critic: Endpoint tangency accuracy not observable, resting on a prior measurement
round2Fixes.done: accuracy.mjs reads SolidCraft's solved points from the @sketch dump: joint perpendicularity, gap, end-radius mismatch, volume, max_residual over stored + 30 rough starts per fixture

round2Fixes.critic: lock supported but a separate wrong row for arcs off the circle
round2Fixes.done: preflight refuses any arc whose ends are not on its circle, so lock-on-c cannot pin a three-point circumcentre
reproduced (profiles-test.mjs), shipped selector row is wrong, evenOddProfiles (winding number) is the contract selector
probes.mjs: both slots x four row orders x three amplitudes x 24 starts, shipped vs guarded, with SolidCraft's own error texts counted

round2Fixes.critic: Param drag across a branch not measured
round2Fixes.done: param-grid.mjs: 13 x 7 angle grid and 6 x 6 signed-distance grid; refused with a sentence, never wrong

round2Fixes.critic: Origin reference without an end: mapper accepts, brep-rs refuses
round2Fixes.done: preflight refuses it with brep-rs's meaning in plain words; the repro shows both engines

rigNotes: sketch-constraints-r4/pkg2shim/solidcraft_referee_p2.js emulates wrapper2 command results by replaying prefixes on the phase0 wrapper; its @sketch result is always {error:"no evaluated sketch"}, so any code that needs solved points (ladderSketch, classify, docProfileIndices) cannot run on it.

Under this rig the shipped profile selection (docProfileIndices) is also unavailable, so multi-profile sketches are extruded with every profile: those cases show the known "extrudes every profile" wrong build, and are not evidence about the contract selector.

The first full sweep in one process ran past 10 minutes because 80 rough-start extrusions of circles take about 0.3 to 0.7 s each; it was not a hang. circle-circle-internal 81 of 81 runs built the wrong volume in 61 s.
